title: What to Expect in Markets this Week: SpaceX’s First Earnings Report; Earnings From Chip and Memory Giants; Jobs Report
excerpt: Investors will hear from Elon Musk’s space venture, and from AI suppliers AMD, SanDisk, and others.
content_html:
Sarina Trangle

Sun, August 2, 2026 at 2:00 AM MST 6 min read

Elon Musk gets plenty of attention. He'll get even more this week.

SpaceX is set to issue its first quarterly earnings report as a public company Tuesday afternoon, calling attention to Silicon Valley's surging investment in AI and the supply chain supporting the buildout. The results will follow a volatile seven weeks for Elon Musk's newly public moonshot.

The rocket, connectivity and AI company sold shares for $135 in the largest initial public offering on record in June. The stock shot up in its first days, surpassing $225, and then steadily slid, falling below its IPO price and touching a low of $107 last week. 

Enthusiasm for SpaceX stock has flagged amid operational setbacks and a pullback in AI stocks. Tech giants have issued new stock and used debt to finance their increasingly expensive AI data center buildout, raising questions about when the investments will pay off. Investors recently dumped shares of several Magnificent 7 members, including Musk's EV maker Tesla, after the companies indicated their AI spending spree is far from over.

SpaceX and its counterparts' big AI spending has been a tailwind for chip, memory and data storage stocks, which have soared this year as builders snapped up their products. Suppliers, including Advanced Micro Devices, Western Digital and SanDisk, will report this week, along with energy companies benefiting from the AI boom.

This week also offers earnings from outside Silicon Valley. A number of consumer companies report, including the streaming service Spotify and media giants Paramount Skydance and Walt Disney. Results are also expected from McDonald's, Wendy's and the parent company of Burger King and Popeyes.

Market Recap

The major stock indexes plunged mid-week, though they managed to end the week with gains across the board, helped by an upbeat finish to Friday's session. The Dow had its worst day in 15 months on Wednesday as the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged. Stocks started to regain ground Thursday, when data showed the Fed's preferred inflation index cooled in June. Mega-cap tech stocks added to the turbulence throughout the week with mixed earnings reports. For the month, the Nasdaq Composite fell 3.2%, while the Dow edged higher and the S&P 500 just ticked lower. For more, read Friday's market recap here. 

This Week's Top Events

Here's a look at major events this week. TradingView publishes a more detailed calendar, but clicking the link will take you off the Investopedia site.

  • Monday, Aug. 3: Palantir (PLTR) is set to release its second-quarter results after the market closes, and host a webcast at 5 p.m. ET. The company, which operates an AI platform and makes data analytics software, vastly outperformed expectations last quarter and raised its outlook.

  • Tuesday, Aug. 4: Spotify (SPOT) is scheduled to publish its results before the opening bell and host a question-and-answer session at 8 a.m. ET. The streaming service raised prices and posted strong results earlier this year. 

  • Tuesday: McDonald's (MCD) is slated to hold a conference call on its results at 8:30 a.m. ET, with the numbers expected before then. The industry has been trying to bring back inflation-weary lower-income consumers with deals, while working to attract higher-income diners. Other restaurant chains are reporting this week, including Shake Shack (SHAK), Sweetgreen (SG), Wendy's (WEN), Outback Steakhouse operator Bloomin' Brands (BLMN) and Restaurant Brands International (QSR), the parent company of Burger King and Popeyes.

  • Tuesday: SpaceX (SPCX) is scheduled to release its results after the market closes and host a live audio webcast at 4:30 p.m. ET. 

  • Tuesday: Pinterest (PINS) is set to publish its results after the closing bell and host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. The social media company posted strong results last quarter and credited AI with improving its ad services.

  • Tuesday: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) will host a conference call on its results at 5 p.m. ET, with the figures expected before then. The media conglomerate came out on top of a bidding war with Netflix (NFLX) for the acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). Investors have been wary of Paramount's plan to finance the purchase with $24 billion from foreign sovereign wealth funds and $54 billion in debt. The Walt Disney Co. (DIS) will report fiscal third-quarter results on Wednesday morning, which will be its second report under CEO Josh D'Amaro. 

  • Tuesday: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) plans to release its second-quarter results after the closing bell and host a conference call at 5 p.m. ET. The chipmaker beat expectations last quarter, and bolstered enthusiasm by announcing Microsoft is using its Helios rack-scale system, which is designed to train massive AI models.

  • Wednesday, Aug. 5: Uber (UBER) is slated to hold a conference call on its results at 8 a.m., with the numbers expected beforehand. The rideshare and food delivery company handed in better-than-expected results last quarter, despite rising competition and gas prices. Uber recently struck deals with the electric vehicle company Rivian (RIVN) and chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA) as it and Lyft (LYFT)—which reports Thursday—look to dispatch more self-driving cars.

  • Wednesday: Eli Lilly (LLY) plans to publish its results and hold a conference call at 10 a.m. ET. The pharmaceutical company released better-than-expected numbers last quarter and lifted its outlook thanks to strong demand for weight-loss drugs. Its rival Novo Nordisk (NVO) posts results Wednesday morning.

  • Wednesday: Western Digital (WDC) is slated to release its fiscal fourth-quarter results after the market closes, and host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. SanDisk

  • (SNDK) is also set to discuss its fiscal fourth-quarter results at that time. Memory and data storage company stocks and earnings have surged amid an AI-driven shortage. Investors have recently been concerned that the industry's blistering growth may not be sustainable as some tech firms redesign products to cut memory costs.

  • Friday, Aug. 7: Oklo (OKLO) is set to publish its results before the opening bell, followed by a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET. The nuclear energy startup has generated buzz while forging a partnership with Nvidia and Los Alamos National Laboratory, and advancing in negotiations to secure fuel from the government for its reactors. Wall Street is keeping an eye on energy companies like Oklo and Constellation Energy (CEG), which reports Thursday, as AI drives demand for power.

  • Friday: The Bureau of Labor Statistics is scheduled to release employment data for July at 8:30 a.m. ET. The monthly jobs report is among the more important economic data releases every month, serving as a key input in Federal Reserve decision-making on interest rates. The labor market has rebounded this year after a rough stretch in 2025, with employers in a "low-hire, low-fire mode" that has frustrated job seekers but helped sustain economic growth. The Fed, under new Chair Kevin Warsh, has been more focused on taming inflation amid the signs of stability in the labor market. Economists expect that employers added 85,000 jobs last month, up from 57,000 in June.

blocks.html_en: • Friday: The Bureau of Labor Statistics is scheduled to release employment data for July at 8:30 a.m. ET. The monthly jobs report is among the more important economic data releases every month, serving as a key input in Federal Reserve decision-making on interest rates. The labor market has rebounded this year after a rough stretch in 2025, with employers in a "low-hire, low-fire mode" that has frustrated job seekers but helped sustain economic growth. The Fed, under new Chair Kevin Warsh, has been more focused on taming inflation amid the signs of stability in the labor market. Economists expect that employers added 85,000 jobs last month, up from 57,000 in June.

萨琳娜被勒死

2026 年 8 月 2 日星期日凌晨 2:00 MST 阅读 6 分钟

埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 受到广泛关注。 这周他会得到更多。

SpaceX 将于周二下午发布其作为上市公司的第一份季度收益报告，引起人们对硅谷在人工智能和支持扩建的供应链方面的投资激增的关注。 埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)新公开的登月计划将经历动荡的七周，结果将在接下来的七周内公布。

这家火箭、连接和人工智能公司在 6 月份以 135 美元的价格出售了有记录以来最大规模的首次公开募股。 该股上市首日飙升，突破 225 美元，随后稳步下滑，跌破 IPO 价格，并于上周触及 107 美元的低点。

由于运营受挫和人工智能股票回调，人们对 SpaceX 股票的热情已经减弱。 科技巨头发行了新股，并利用债务为其日益昂贵的人工智能数据中心建设提供资金，引发了人们对投资何时能获得回报的疑问。 投资者最近抛售了几家 Magnificent 7 成员的股票，其中包括马斯克的电动汽车制造商特斯拉，因为这些公司表示他们的人工智能支出热潮远未结束。

SpaceX 及其同行的巨额人工智能支出一直是芯片、内存和数据存储股票的推动力，随着建筑商抢购其产品，这些股票今年飙升。 Advanced Micro Devices、Western Digital 和 SanDisk 等供应商以及受益于人工智能热潮的能源公司将于本周发布报告。

本周还提供来自硅谷以外地区的财报。 许多消费公司都报告了这一情况，包括流媒体服务 Spotify 以及媒体巨头派拉蒙 Skydance 和华特迪士尼。 麦当劳、温迪以及汉堡王和大力水手的母公司也预计将公布业绩。

市场回顾

主要股指在周中暴跌，但在周五收盘的乐观收盘的帮助下，它们在本周结束时全线上涨。 周三，由于美联储维持利率不变，道琼斯指数遭遇 15 个月来最糟糕的一天。 周四，数据显示美联储首选通胀指数在 6 月份降温，股市开始收复失地。 大型科技股的盈利报告好坏参半，加剧了本周的动荡。 本月，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 3.2%，道琼斯指数小幅走高，标准普尔 500 指数小幅走低。 欲了解更多信息，请阅读周五的市场回顾。

本周的热门活动

  • 8 月 4 日星期二：Spotify (SPOT) 计划在开盘前公布业绩，并于上午 8 点举行问答环节。 和。 今年早些时候，该流媒体服务提高了价格并公布了强劲的业绩。

  • 周二：SpaceX (SPCX) 计划在收盘后发布业绩，并于下午 4:30 举办现场音频网络广播。 和。
  • 周二：Pinterest (PINS) 定于收盘后公布业绩，并于下午 4:30 召开电话会议。 和。 这家社交媒体公司上季度公布了强劲的业绩，并将其广告服务的改善归功于人工智能。
  • 周二：派拉蒙 Skydance (PSKY) 将于下午 5 点召开业绩电话会议。 ET，与之前的预期数字相同。 这家媒体集团在与 Netflix (NFLX) 收购华纳兄弟的竞购战中脱颖而出。 发现（WBD）。 投资者一直对派拉蒙利用外国主权财富基金 240 亿美元和 540 亿美元债务融资的计划持谨慎态度。 华特迪士尼公司 （DIS）将于周三上午公布第三财季业绩，这将是其首席执行官乔什·达马罗（Josh D'Amaro）领导下的第二份报告。
  • 周二：Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 计划在收盘后发布第二季度业绩，并于下午 5 点召开电话会议。 和。 这家芯片制造商上季度超出了预期，并宣布微软正在使用其 Helios 机架规模系统，该系统旨在训练大规模人工智能模型，从而激发了人们的热情。
  • 8 月 5 日星期三：优步 (UBER) 定于上午 8 点召开业绩电话会议，数据是事先预计的。 尽管竞争加剧和汽油价格上涨，这家拼车和食品配送公司上季度的业绩好于预期。 Uber 最近与电动汽车公司 Rivian (RIVN) 和芯片制造商 Nvidia (NVDA) 达成了协议，因为它和 Lyft (LYFT)（周四发布报告）希望派遣更多自动驾驶汽车。
  • 周三：礼来公司 (LLY) 计划公布业绩并于上午 10 点举行电话会议。 和。 该制药公司上季度公布的数据好于预期，并由于减肥药的强劲需求而上调了预期。 其竞争对手诺和诺德（NVO）周三上午公布了业绩。
  • 周三：西部数据 (WDC) 定于收盘后发布第四财季业绩，并于下午 4:30 召开电话会议。 和。 闪迪
  • （SNDK）届时也将讨论其第四财季业绩。 由于人工智能驱动的短缺，内存和数据存储公司的股票和收益大幅上涨。 投资者最近担心，随着一些科技公司重新设计产品以降低内存成本，该行业的快速增长可能无法持续。
  • 8 月 7 日星期五：Oklo (OKLO) 定于开盘前公布业绩，随后于上午 8:30 召开电话会议。 和。 这家核能初创公司与英伟达和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室建立了合作伙伴关系，并推进了从政府获得其反应堆燃料的谈判，引起了轰动。 随着人工智能推动电力需求，华尔街正在密切关注 Oklo 和 Constellation Energy (CEG) 等能源公司，该公司周四发布了报告。
  • 周五：美国劳工统计局定于上午 8:30 发布 7 月份就业数据。 和。 月度就业报告是每月发布的较为重要的经济数据之一，是美联储利率决策的关键投入。 经过 2025 年的艰难时期后，今年劳动力市场出现反弹，雇主处于“低聘、低解雇模式”，这让求职者感到沮丧，但有助于维持经济增长。 在新任主席凯文·沃什的领导下，美联储在劳动力市场出现稳定迹象的情况下更加关注抑制通胀。 经济学家预计上个月雇主增加了 85,000 个工作岗位，高于 6 月份的 57,000 个。
